connector.name: EWS Meeting MCP
connector.registryDescription: Safely schedule Outlook meetings on on-prem Exchange EWS with preview-confirmed writes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ews-meeting-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ap311036 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EWS_EMAIL
env.description: Mailbox email address used as the meeting organizer.

env.name: EWS_USERNAME
env.description: Exchange login username, often DOMAIN\username for NTLM.

env.name: EWS_PASSWORD
env.description: Exchange password. Prefer macOS Keychain variables when possible.

env.name: EWS_PASSWORD_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE
env.description: Optional macOS Keychain service name for reading the password locally.

env.name: EWS_PASSWORD_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT
env.description: Optional macOS Keychain account. Defaults to EWS_USERNAME when omitted.

env.name: EWS_AUTH_TYPE
env.description: Exchange auth type. Usually NTLM for on-prem Exchange.
